A '''TC-series protocol droid''' was part of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] pool aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. This [[TC-series protocol droid/Legends|TC-series droid]] was requisitioned to welcome the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] who arrived aboard the ''Executor'' during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Hoth campaign]] to participate in [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] hunt for [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].
